name: EnhancedFin
description: Ratings, watchlist, resume, follows and release calendar for Jellyfin users.
overview: A personal layer on top of your library, keyed on TMDB: ratings, watchlist, continue watching, followed shows and a release calendar. Powers the discovery features of the SweetFin iOS client.

versions.changelog:
Adds GET /me/next-up/{key}: the next episode to watch of a show (in progress,
otherwise the one after the last watched, otherwise S1E1).
Continue watching now lists the next episode of a show whose last episode is
watched, with the episode name, and ignores items below the server's resume
threshold (MinResumePct), like Jellyfin.
Adds the IMDb id and the original language to the media details.
Adds the TMDB attribution (logo and notice) to the settings page.
